item.title: Vietnam urges work from home to save fuel amid Iran war supply crunch
item.description: Vietnam calls for remote work to cut fuel use as Iran war disrupts imports, causing severe shortages and price spikes across the country.

item.title: Floods hit Kuching, Bau & Lundu as students evacuated
item.description: Flash floods sweep southern Sarawak as 120 students and 14 teachers are evacuated from SK Segong in Bau by boat.

item.title: Airlines hike fares globally as war fuels jet fuel crisis
item.description: Global airlines raise fares and suspend outlooks as Middle East conflict sends jet fuel prices soaring, impacting travel demand and airline shares.

item.title: South Korea cannot block US weapons redeployment to Middle East
item.description: South Korea says it cannot stop US forces from redeploying weapons to the Middle East, raising concerns over regional defence gaps and potential North Korean miscalculation.
